claims.population: The article gives a population of 760,084 at the 2006 census.
claims.climate: The article gives a tropical savanna climate (Aw) with a yearly mean temperature of 25.2 C and 39.3 inches of yearly rain.
claims.industry: The article calls Kaduna a major industrial centre of Northern Nigeria manufacturing textiles, machinery, steel, aluminium, petroleum products and bearings, and says the textile industry has declined.
claims.agriculture: The article lists cotton, peanuts, sorghum and ginger among the main agricultural exports.
